BiblicalUsage: Hiddai is a person named once in Scripture, in 2 Samuel. The full story lives on the Hiddai profile, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: God keeps Hiddai in His book for a reason, and I take that seriously. I hold that every name in Scripture is there on purpose, even the ones the Bible says little about.
